QUOTE: "the callback only notifies, and the deny list is the only thing left that can stop an unlisted call" and "if is_denied(pattern) → "Error: Permission denied" ◄── deny list wins here"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names ServerManager::execute consulting is_denied, but it also lists other blockers (hooks, schema check, tier check, allow-list "Permission denied" when no callback), so it does not conclude that the deny list is the only blocker. The "only thing left" claim is limited to the callback case.
